title: the math calls of Exudyn through EXUmath, switched to the portable functions by EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG4.1.3.3: the transcendental functions of the C++ code (sin, cos, ..., not the graphics) go through EXUmath::Sin, ..., which call the C++ library or, with the macro EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH, EXUmath::Portable; the test suite with the switch on Windows and Linux shows which entries of UnresolvedOnLinux() the math library causes, and what the switch costs in time
releaseNotes: the transcendental functions of the C++ code go through EXUmath::Sin, Cos, ..., which call the C++ library, or the portable functions with the switch EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH (BasicDefinitions.h, off; exudyn.config.Version(True) says PORTABLEMATH); off, every result is unchanged; on, on Windows and Linux, the friction and contact models generalContactFrictionTests, sphereTriangleTest2, generalContactImplicit1 and three more agree to the last bit, at no measurable cost in time
